purpose: Freeze the deterministic mapping from authoritative Weekly ETF runtime state and governed evidence into the required Weekly Review structure without granting delivery or execution authority.

composes.rule: ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT defines the canonical runtime input/state authority order and normalized report-state bridge. This assembly contract consumes that authority and may not replace, reorder or duplicate it.

authoritative_inputs.rule: Use only current integrated repository governance; narrative does not override machine state.
This is the canonical input/state authority contract for report assembly. Its authority order is binding.
Primary holdings, cash, prior NAV, position metadata and implemented state authority as defined by ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT.
Latest canonical pricing audit and FX basis under ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT; provenance and freshness must remain admissible.
Canonical research-breadth and lane-ranking input under ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT.
Canonical capital re-underwriting and recommendation-memory input under ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT.
Deterministic normalized bridge produced from the canonical runtime authority order. Review assembly should consume this bridge where available rather than reconstructing a parallel state model.
This contract composes existing methodology; it does not silently change thresholds, scoring, product identity or portfolio philosophy.

advisory_inputs.rule: May inform review analysis only when admissible under current project governance and consistent with canonical runtime state.
Explicitly non-authoritative. Never production truth, report-state authority or portfolio-action authority unless promoted through an explicit reviewed architecture decision.

runtime_authority_order: prior markdown report as historical display context only
fail_closed_conditions: runtime state inconsistent with ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT authority order
attempt to treat shadow, lab or historical report values as current authority

output_contract.ordering_rule: Emit every section exactly once in the listed order. Client layer precedes analyst layer.
output_contract.content_rule: For identical authoritative inputs, evidence set and methodology revision, material classifications, scores, actions, holdings/cash state and continuity output must be reproducible; wording may vary only where it does not change meaning.
output_contract.identity_rule: The assembled review must retain exact references to the authoritative runtime state, pricing/evidence identities and methodology revision consumed for the run so later QA can bind the output to its inputs.

side_effects.note: Assembly may describe recommendations or already-authoritative executed model state, but this contract itself cannot perform or authorize any of these side effects.

product_boundaries: US Weekly ETF identity remains authoritative for this repository
ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT remains the sole runtime input/state authority contract
EU UCITS/investability semantics are not imported
FX runtime/output semantics are not imported
no second pricing, portfolio, ledger or state authority is created
deterministic_acceptance: all required authoritative input classes resolve to explicit repository paths
ETF_RUNTIME_STATE_CONTRACT authority order is explicitly composed and unchanged
normalized output/runtime report state is the canonical assembly bridge where available
shadow and lab inputs are explicitly non-authoritative unless promoted
required output sections and order are fixed
delivery and financial side effects remain unauthorized
